// Integrations, hub: the Orbit mark in the middle with eight integration tiles around it, four a side, // joined to it by dashed lines (an SVG stretched over the hub; the tiles sit at fixed heights so the // lines meet them). The lines and the ring are decoration; the tiles are a real list. On phones the hub // becomes a plain two-column grid. The tiles are kinds of tool, not real brands; put your partners' names // and logos in their place. The dashes drift slowly, and stand still for people who turn motion off. import { ArrowRight, Calculator, CalendarDays, CreditCard, Landmark, Mail, MessageSquare, Sheet, Webhook } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" const LEFT = [ { icon: CreditCard, name: "Card payments", body: "Cards and digital wallets" }, { icon: Landmark, name: "Bank transfer", body: "Local transfers in 30 currencies" }, { icon: Calculator, name: "Accounting", body: "Invoices and payments in sync" }, { icon: Sheet, name: "Spreadsheets", body: "A live copy of every invoice" }, ] const RIGHT = [ { icon: Mail, name: "Email", body: "Send from your own address" }, { icon: MessageSquare, name: "Team chat", body: "A ping when an invoice is paid" }, { icon: CalendarDays, name: "Calendar", body: "Due dates on your calendar" }, { icon: Webhook, name: "Webhooks and API", body: "Build on top of Orbit" }, ] // The hub is 440px tall and the tiles 64px, spaced evenly: their centers, in % of the height. const H = 440 const TILE = 64 const ROWS = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((k) => ((TILE / 2 + (k * (H - TILE)) / 3) / H) * 100) // Columns: 32% | 36% | 32%. Left tiles end at 32%, right tiles start at 68%, the mark is at 50%. const PATHS = [...ROWS.map((y) => `M50 50 C41 50 41 ${y} 32 ${y}`), ...ROWS.map((y) => `M50 50 C59 50 59 ${y} 68 ${y}`)] const KEYFRAMES = `@keyframes dc-hub-flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -18 } }` type Item = (typeof LEFT)[number] function Tile({ item, className }: { item: Item; className?: string }) { const Icon = item.icon return (
